filename_rule.handling: The pinned source is already canonical; no source rename was performed. A byte-identical same-name staging copy was made for the helper input and cache.

principles: Use the designated local folder as content authority; never rename, overwrite, or re-render its files.
Use a fresh empty staging directory and copy bytes with canonical page-NNN.jpg names.
Run the unchanged helper ingest against the staging directory, then compare SHA-256 for every source, staging, and cache file.
Keep all source images, PDFs, staging files, and canonical cache files ignored and local-only.
restoration_procedure.verification: Repeat for page-001.jpg through page-450.jpg; require original_sha256 == staged_sha256 == canonical_sha256 and require the catalog inventory digest to remain unchanged.
